, have not supported the version of prosecution

PW-2 has categorically deposed in his examination-in-chief that the persons who had caused injuries to him on the day of incident are not present in the Court.

In the present case, PW-2 and PW-4 failed to identify accused persons namely Vishal @ Ganja, Sachin @ Monty (proceedings abated vide order dated 24.09.2025), Pardeep and Gautam @ Bouncer as the persons who had committed the alleged incident.

Further, as already discussed above, third eye-witness namely Sh. Happy remained untraceable despite service through DCP and IO concerned and his named was dropped from the list of prosecution witnesses.

Therefore, in the present case,
continuing further with the trial would have been an exercise in futility as even if the remaining case would have been taken on face value, there is not even a remote possibility of conviction of above-named four accused persons.

17. In case titled as Satish Mehra v. Delhi Administration & Anr. 1996 JCC 507 Hon'ble Supreme Court of India has held that "in a case where, there is no prospect of the case ending in conviction the valuable time of Court should not be wasted for holding a trial only for the purpose of formally completing the procedure to pronounce the conclusion on the future date".

sentences.text: 18. The burden of proof on the prosecution is to prove the case by leading cogent, convincing and reliance evidence to prove the guilt of accused persons beyond reasonable doubt.
Accused cannot be convicted on the basis of mere probabilities or presumptions.

Suspicion, howsoever grave may be,
cannot take place of proof.
Every benefit of doubt goes in favor of accused.

19. There is nothing on record to establish the culpability of accused persons namely Vishal @
Ganja, Pardeep and Gautam @ Bouncer in the commission of the offences, charged against them.

The case of the prosecution has fallen like a pack of cards.

In the present case, PW-2 and PW-4 failed to identify accused persons namely Vishal @ Ganja, Sachin @ Monty (proceedings abated vide order dated 24.09.2025), Pardeep and Gautam @ Bouncer as the persons who had committed the alleged incident.
Therefore, their examination would have been a futile exercise and that would have caused unnecessary expenditure on the State exchequer.
Therefore, in the present case,
continuing further with the trial would have been an exercise in futility as even if the remaining case would have been taken on face value, there is not even a remote possibility of conviction of above-named four accused persons.
17. In case titled as Satish Mehra v. Delhi Administration & Anr. 1996 JCC 507 Hon'ble Supreme Court of India has held that "in a case where, there is no prospect of the case ending in conviction the valuable time of Court should not be wasted for holding a trial only for the purpose of formally completing the procedure to pronounce the conclusion on the future date".
18. The burden of proof on the prosecution is to prove the case by leading cogent, convincing and reliance evidence to prove the guilt of accused persons beyond reasonable doubt.
Accused cannot be convicted on the basis of mere probabilities or presumptions.
Suspicion, howsoever grave may be,
cannot take place of proof.
Every benefit of doubt goes in favor of accused.
19. There is nothing on record to establish the culpability of accused persons namely Vishal @
Ganja, Pardeep and Gautam @ Bouncer in the commission of the offences, charged against them.
State vs Vishal @ Ganja Etc (2) on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133838701/

Amarjeet Singh have not supported the version of prosecution and thus, the prosecution has failed to prove its case against accused persons namely Vishal @ SUSHIL KUMAR FIR No. 420/2017 Digitally signed by SUSHIL KUMAR PS Mahendra Park Date: 2025.10.08 14:52:59 +0530 Ganja, Pardeep and Gautam @ Bouncer beyond reasonable doubt.
In the light of the above testimony of PW-2 / Complainant Sh. Vishal and PW-4 Sh. Amarjeet Singh, accused persons namely Vishal @ Ganja, Pardeep and Gautam @ Bouncer cannot be held guilty for offences alleged against them.
